note: LIVE reproduction of the same defect class already confirmed on bodha_graph_subgraph_get/bodha_graph_traverse_get, on a DIFFERENT tool (catalog_assets_list). Mechanism: platform-mcp/src/tools/register_p1_aliases.ts:188 `function dualOutput(data: unknown, toolName = 'unknown_tool')`; catalog_assets_list's own registration (near line 1137) calls `dualOutput(data)` with no second argument (bare call at line 1155), so the default fires whenever autoDetectTrimmableSections finds something to cut. Source grep found ~20 more `dualOutput(data)` bare-call sites in the SAME file sharing this exact defect (catalog_assets_all, catalog_assets_l0, ref_vector_search, ref_remedies_get, ref_remedies_chart_get, ref_remedies_by_category_list, ref_remedy_get, ref_tantric_remedies_get, ref_remedies_by_planet_get, ref_mantras_get, ref_remedies_search, kala_muhurta_get, mimamsa_outcome_record, mimamsa_calibration_get, ganita_natal_positions_compute, ganita_special_lagnas_get, kala_yoga_activation_get, plus bodha_signals_get's own OUTER wrapper as a dormant backstop) — one of these (phala_outlook_get, line ~1802) was already patched (RC-04, 2026-07-23) to pass the real tool name; the rest were not.
